data.action: 浴衣并肩牵手走过摊位，烟花亮起时侧头微笑
data.camera: medium two-shot, festival crowd, hand holding, firework glow
data.description: 【夏祭街道·夜】紫藤花纹的浴衣衬着忍的笑靥，苹果糖的甜香混在祭典的喧嚣里。人潮涌动的路口，她自然而然地把手递给你——「人潮里牵着就不会走散了。……嗯？脸红什么，只是防走失措施而已哦？……啊，烟花开始了。不快点看的话，就要错过了。」
data.lighting: 灯笼暖光与远处烟花的冷艳
data.promptProse: Kochou Shinobu walks the festival crowd in her wisteria-patterned yukata, the sweet smell of candy apples weaving through the lantern-lit noise. At the crowded crossing she simply offers her hand — easier not to get separated, she says, and when you take it your face heats as she teases that it is only an anti-lost measure. The first firework blooms overhead and she tilts her head with a smile, urging you to look before it fades. Medium two-shot, cinematic lighting, lantern glow, detailed festival background.
data.title: 蝴蝶忍 · 夏祭夜路的并肩·「人潮里，牵着就不会走散了」
